description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Estimates how many LLM tokens a text uses with a documented offline heuristic (not an exact tokenizer; typically within about 15% for English), with a low/high range, characters, words, lines and UTF-8 bytes. Input: text (POST for long text). Limit: 400,000 characters.

text.description: Plain text or Markdown, 1-400,000 characters (short text in the query; long text as POST JSON {"text": "..."})

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: token_count

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Token count estimate (plus characters, words, bytes) ($0.002/call)
